planning_decision: Changed place, activity, garment silhouettes and direction/frame pairs from the inspected recent images; each character has three distinct categories, expressions, poses, directions and frames.
finalFacePrompt: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): elongated face, long length, narrow width; angular defined jaw; almond eyes, medium size, downturned outer corners, average spacing; long arched brows; balanced nose; thin lips.
faceComparison: Actual light images compared with Pelipper, Ralts and Kirlia: Gardevoir has a longer narrow lower face, defined chin and smaller downturned almond eyes; hair and ornaments excluded in judging these facial proportions.
